lines.text: Jehu deceptively summons all Baal's servants to a great sacrifice, and every one of them comes to the temple.
Jehu has garments brought out for Baal's servants and stations sixty men outside the temple of Baal.
The guards and officers kill Baal's servants, then burn the sacred pillar and make the temple into a latrine.
Jehu eradicates Baal from Israel but does not turn away from the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
Hazael defeats the Israelites, and Jehu is buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz reigns after him.
